title: Capvision Partners HKEX IPO (Ticker: 810221) Remains Pending After Multi-Year Filing Process
summary: Shanghai-based Capvision Partners has ticker 810221 reserved on the HKEX after multiple filing attempts since 2021, aiming to raise $300M at a $1.5-3B valuation. The IPO has not yet completed, with the process delayed following a 2022-2023 regulatory crackdown in China. The company remains privately held.
